## Editorial note

The mapped files `originals/history__medieval-soundspace.html` and `originals/history__medieval-soundspace.txt` are not the article. They contain only an Anubis proof-of-work bot challenge from the Universitat de Lleida repository, so the original article text is unavailable in the supplied sources.

Existing research indicates that the abstract and relevant PDF text were inspected, but that material is not present in the supplied HTML/TXT originals and cannot be reconstructed here without inventing content.
